source.handler: handleDashscopeTtsSpeech: POST { model, input: { text: input, voice: voice.trim() || longanlingxin }, parameters: { format: mp3, sample_rate: 24000 } } with Content-Type application/json + Authorization Bearer; non-2xx forwarded through upstreamErrorResponse; a JSON code is a 502 even with HTTP 200; output.audio.data base64 wins, else output.audio.url is downloaded with fetchRemoteMedia (public-only, pinned DNS, 50 MiB); answer audio/mpeg

exports.dashscopeTtsAdapter: default TTS adapter instance; synthesize(text, model, credentials, responseFormat, options)
exports.createDashscopeTtsAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, downloadFetchImpl, timeoutMs, downloadTimeoutMs, maxAudioBytes } for tests
exports.buildDashscopeTtsRequest: (model, text, options) -> source body; throws status 400 for any field the source would drop
exports.normalizeDashscopeTtsFormat: mp3 aliases (plus json) or omitted -> mp3, else null
exports.dashscopeTtsRegionSupported: (providerSpecificData) -> whether the connection region selects the Singapore host
exports.downloadDashscopeTtsAudio: (url, { signal, fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxBytes }) -> { bytes } | { failure }; no credential, no redirects, public-only
exports.dashscopeTtsAccounting: (data, model) -> accounting with reported *_tokens and usage.characters, cost unknown
exports.DASHSCOPE_TTS_PROVIDER_ADDITIONS: staged additions to the existing qwen-cloud-token-plan registry entry (serviceKinds, model row, ttsConfig)
exports.DASHSCOPE_TTS_CONFIG: ttsConfig block { baseUrl, authType, authHeader, format, supportedFormats, defaultVoice, models }
exports.DASHSCOPE_TTS_SINGAPORE_REGIONS: source region aliases that select the Singapore host
exports.DASHSCOPE_TTS_MAX_ENVELOPE_BYTES: base64 of the audio cap plus 64 KiB

provider.regions: providerSpecificData.region unset or a Singapore alias only; any other region refused with 400 before submit

models.voiceSuffix: refused: the voice comes from the voice field (default longanlingxin)

speech.answer: application/json { output: { audio: { data | url } }, usage?, request_id } or { code, message }
